import json
from work import evaluate

p={"defaults":{"b":True,"i":3,"s":"x"},"types":{"b":"boolean","i":"integer","s":"string"},"null_resets":True,"environment":True}
cases=[
 ({"layers":[{"b":False,"i":0,"s":""}]},{"ok":True,"config":{"b":False,"i":0,"s":""},"error":None}),
 ({"layers":[{"i":9},{"i":None}]},{"ok":True,"config":{"b":True,"i":3,"s":"x"},"error":None}),
 ({"layers":[{"bad":1}]},{"ok":False,"config":{},"error":"unknown_key"}),
 ({"environment":{"b":"false","i":"-12","s":""}},{"ok":True,"config":{"b":False,"i":-12,"s":""},"error":None}),
 ({"environment":{"b":"False"}},{"ok":False,"config":{},"error":"environment"}),
 ({"environment":{"i":" 2"}},{"ok":False,"config":{},"error":"environment"}),
 ({"layers":[{"i":True}]},{"ok":False,"config":{},"error":"type"}),
 ({"layers":[{"i":"bad"}],"environment":{"i":"+4"}},{"ok":True,"config":{"b":True,"i":4,"s":"x"},"error":None})]
for n,(req,want) in enumerate(cases):
 got=evaluate(req,p)
 assert got==want,(n,got,want)
policy=json.load(open('policy.json'))
requests=json.load(open('requests.json'))
report=json.load(open('report.json'))
actual=[evaluate(r,policy) for r in requests]
assert report==actual,(report,actual)
print('ok',len(cases),'edge cases; report matches',len(requests),'request(s)')
